description: fz-9zq.4 (#639) replaced seven hand-copied five-axis traversals with Descr::children / map_children (types/children.rs). These still walk the axes by hand: clash.rs and addressed.rs (they carry state), canon/format (they render text), and collect_protocol_domain_obligations (positive signatures only; documented in type-world.md). For each, decide on paper whether it can use the shared child walk with its state threaded through (for example, a ChildRole filter for positive-only), or whether it asks a different question and stays separate, documented why. One question, one implementation.
title: Stateful type traversals share the Descr child walk
